name: Token theft
short_description: Token theft is an attack in which an adversary steals and replays a user's session or access token, for example after adversary-in-the-middle phishing, to act as the user without needing the password or passing MFA again.

evidence.quote: when the token replays the replay hits tempered glass
Stolen tokens, right past it, like cloaked ships through an open gate.
We'll track consent fishing, token theft and OAuth abuse.
